description: OkCupid's response-rate data (2009-2014) and a study of 2.4 million heterosexual interactions on Facebook's 'Are You Interested?' both found Black men, Black women and Asian men received the fewest responses; white men and Asian women the most.
notes: IMPORTANT CALIBRATION: Middle Eastern men are NOT typically the lowest-response group in these datasets. The disadvantage is real but smaller than the folk version, and the folk version is itself harmful.

aspect: Why the Middle Eastern numbers are weak
description: One analysis flags sampling problems: OkCupid skewed young, educated and liberal, probably representing whites better than Middle Easterners, with more assimilated users self-selecting onto the platform specifically to date outside their group.

aspect: Stated preference moved; behaviour did not
description: Between 2009 and 2014 the share of OkCupid users saying they would date someone with a vocal racial bias fell from 27% to 10% - while actual behaviour barely changed.
energy_note: Everyone got better at saying it and nobody changed.

description: Users tend to segregate by race, and where a demographic receives fewer swipes the algorithm shows them to fewer people - a feedback loop that turns a modest initial skew into a large practical one.
energy_note: A small bias, compounded by software into a wall.

aspect: Status insecurity as its own filter
description: Independent of ethnicity: a man on a temporary permit who cannot say where he will live in eighteen months, cannot sign a lease or a mortgage, and may be refused re-entry, is a poor prospect for anyone planning a life. The visa does the filtering the prejudice is blamed for.

It comes on the third date, always kindly: so are you staying? Omid explains maintained status, the background check, the possibility of a refusal. He watches her do the arithmetic he has already done. There is no bad behaviour anywhere in the evening.
energy_note: Rejected by a spreadsheet nobody wrote down.

aspect: The belief does damage on its own
description: A man who believes he is categorically unwanted approaches fewer people, invests less, and reads ordinary rejection as confirmation. The folk statistic is more disabling than the real one.
notes: Deliberate: the honest reading of the data is also the more useful one. See PSY-009 - part of why this data is poor is that it collapses Iranians into a Middle Eastern bucket they do not belong in.
